summary: The purpose of this project is to provide a deeper understanding of Hartree-Fock theory by demonstrating a simple implementation of the self-consistent-field method. The theoretical background can be found in Ch. 3 of the text by Szabo and Ostlund or in the nice set of on-line notes written by David Sherrill.
